title: Spicy Korean Fried Chicken
description: A crispy fried Korean-style chicken dish with a spicy kick. Perfect as a main course or appetizer.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger.
3. Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
4. In a separate bowl, mix together cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
5. Add the cornstarch mixture to the chicken and toss to coat.
6. Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
7. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.
8. Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
9. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
10. Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
11. Toss the chicken with green onions (if using) and serve hot.
